sources.title: Cisco — Out of band best practices
sources.locator: Out of Band Networks; Management Network Devices; Remote Access; Jumpserver
sources.claim: Separate management access, console connection compatibility, controlled administrative access and review of transport/power dependencies. High-level guidance explicitly not a validated universal design.

sources.title: Cisco — NextGen OOB Data Center Management
sources.locator: Out-of-band management and external console access
sources.claim: Dedicated management network and external console reachability are distinct; separate circuits or cellular are external-access examples, not verified coverage.

sources.title: Declared inventory arithmetic
sources.claim: Fleet-wide required assumed ports equal listed console-capable device counts at one connection/device; no per-site allocation or product size inferred.

sources.title: Explicit repeatable conditional planning policy
sources.claim: Input booleans select candidate options and review actions, not proven independence. Critical verified sites remain null. Acknowledgments are user assertions; all site/vendor constraints remain to validate.

en.title: Assumed fleet console-port inventory
en.recommendation: One planned connection per listed console-capable device: routers + switches + firewalls + other devices. This is a planning inventory, not an appliance purchase quantity.
en.tradeoff: Validate actual connectors, adapters, access methods and site allocation. No equal distribution, spare ratio or appliance port size is assumed.

zh.title: 假定全网控制台端口清单
zh.recommendation: 每台已列控制台设备按一个连接规划：路由器＋交换机＋防火墙＋其他设备。这是规划清单，不是控制台服务器采购数量。
zh.tradeoff: 核对实际接口、适配器、访问方式和站点分配；不假设均分、备用比例或设备端口规格。

en.title: Reported separate ISP plus cellular candidate
en.recommendation: Evaluate a dedicated management transport using the reported separate ISP, with cellular as a candidate alternate path. Neither availability flag verifies physical or provider independence.
en.tradeoff: Potential recovery-path diversity adds carrier, firewall and operating dependencies. Verify actual last-mile routes, signal, service, power and outage access at every required site.

zh.title: 已报告独立ISP及蜂窝候选
zh.recommendation: 评估使用已报告独立ISP的专用管理传输，并将蜂窝作为候选替代路径。可用标记不能验证物理或供应商独立性。
zh.tradeoff: 候选恢复路径增加运营商、防火墙及运维依赖。逐站核实末端路由、信号、业务、电源和故障访问。

en.title: Reported separate ISP candidate
en.recommendation: Evaluate the reported ISP circuit for management transport. A separate contract or provider name does not prove separate ducts, termination equipment or failure domains.
en.tradeoff: Investigate a validated alternate recovery path. Carrier service and management-edge availability remain design dependencies, not verified redundancy.

zh.title: 已报告独立ISP候选
zh.recommendation: 评估已报告ISP线路作为管理传输；独立合同或供应商名称不能证明管道、终端设备或故障域独立。
zh.tradeoff: 评估已验证的替代恢复路径。运营商服务与管理边缘可用性仍是设计依赖，非已验证冗余。

en.title: Cellular-only transport candidate
en.recommendation: Evaluate the reported cellular service as an external access candidate because no separate ISP is reported. Its availability at critical sites is unverified.
en.tradeoff: Validate local signal, coverage, data/service constraints, protected access path and power. Keep an on-site recovery procedure; this is not a guaranteed resilient OOB design.

zh.title: 仅蜂窝传输候选
zh.recommendation: 未报告独立ISP时，可评估已报告蜂窝业务作为外部访问候选；关键站点可用性尚未验证。
zh.tradeoff: 验证现场信号、覆盖、数据/业务限制、受控访问路径及电源，保留现场恢复流程；这不是已保证韧性的OOB设计。

en.title: Independent transport unconfirmed
en.recommendation: Neither separate ISP nor cellular is reported. Do not claim a working independent remote OOB path. Identify and validate an external transport or document local recovery requirements.
en.tradeoff: Remote recovery may remain blocked by production-path failure. Confirm feasible provider/site options before accepting this architecture.

zh.title: 独立传输未确认
zh.recommendation: 未报告独立ISP或蜂窝，不应声称已有独立远程OOB路径。需要确定并验证外部传输，或记录现场恢复要求。
zh.tradeoff: 生产路径故障可能阻断远程恢复。接受架构前确认可行的运营商及现场方案。

en.title: Cellular backup needs site validation
en.recommendation: Cellular is user-reported available, not measured coverage. Treat it as a candidate alternate or sole external transport according to the selected architecture.
en.tradeoff: Record per-site signal/service/power and a production-outage access test; no coverage percentage or bandwidth guarantee is inferred.

zh.title: 蜂窝备份需要逐站验证
zh.recommendation: 蜂窝可用由用户报告，并非实测覆盖。按所选架构将其视为候选替代或唯一外部传输。
zh.tradeoff: 逐站记录信号、业务、电源及生产故障下访问测试；不推断覆盖百分比或带宽保证。

en.title: No cellular candidate reported
en.recommendation: Do not assume cellular recovery. Review another permitted transport or an on-site recovery process with the site owner.
en.tradeoff: Adding cellular later requires site and service validation, not just changing a planning checkbox.

zh.title: 未报告蜂窝候选
zh.recommendation: 不能假设蜂窝恢复能力。与站点责任人复核其他获准传输或现场恢复流程。
zh.tradeoff: 后续增加蜂窝需要现场与业务验证，不能仅修改规划复选框。

en.title: Plan remote console rollout
en.recommendation: Map required inventory connections to actual sites and console servers; validate supported console types and a recovery access procedure.
en.tradeoff: Serial/console access and network management interfaces are different access methods. Inventory totals do not define site appliance counts or eliminate device/power dependencies.

zh.title: 规划远程控制台接入
zh.recommendation: 将所需清单连接映射到实际站点及控制台服务器，验证控制台接口与恢复访问流程。
zh.tradeoff: 串行/控制台与网络管理接口是不同访问方式。全网清单不能决定站点设备数量，也不能消除设备/电源依赖。

en.title: Console inventory retained; remote rollout not required
en.recommendation: The assumed inventory-port count is still shown. Remote console rollout is not requested; document which local/vendor recovery method is acceptable.
en.tradeoff: A lower rollout requirement does not reduce the listed device inventory or prove recovery will be available during a management outage.

zh.title: 保留控制台清单；未要求远程部署
zh.recommendation: 仍显示假定控制台端口清单。用户未要求远程控制台部署，应记录可接受的现场/厂商恢复方式。
zh.tradeoff: 降低部署需求不会减少已列设备清单，也不能证明管理故障时具备恢复能力。

en.title: Controlled jump-host or access-broker path requested
en.recommendation: Include a controlled administrative intermediary in the proposed design because the operator requires it. Review authenticated access, role restrictions and auditable sessions.
en.tradeoff: The broker, authentication and logging path can become common dependencies. Validate recovery access during production and broker/identity failures; this planner configures nothing.

zh.title: 要求受控跳板机或访问代理路径
zh.recommendation: 用户要求在候选设计中加入受控管理中介，应复核认证访问、角色限制及可审计会话。
zh.tradeoff: 代理、认证和日志路径可能形成共同依赖。验证生产、代理及身份系统故障下的恢复访问；本工具不配置系统。

en.title: Evaluate controlled remote administration
en.recommendation: Remote console is requested without an explicit jump-host requirement. Evaluate a controlled broker/bastion or equivalent protected administrative path; record why the chosen access boundary is appropriate.
en.tradeoff: An intermediary supports control but adds an outage dependency. Neither automatic direct access nor a universally mandatory jump-host topology is inferred.

zh.title: 评估受控远程管理
zh.recommendation: 要求远程控制台但未明确要求跳板机，应评估受控代理/堡垒机或等效受保护管理路径，并记录访问边界的理由。
zh.tradeoff: 中介有助于访问控制，但增加故障依赖。不自动推定直接访问，也不声称某跳板拓扑普遍强制。

en.title: Document local management access
en.recommendation: Neither remote console nor jump host is requested. Keep a permitted local administrative/recovery procedure and validate the management boundary.
en.tradeoff: This preference is not evidence of enforcement or a recommendation to expose management interfaces directly to untrusted networks.

zh.title: 记录本地管理访问
zh.recommendation: 未要求远程控制台或跳板机，仍需记录获准的本地管理/恢复流程并验证管理边界。
zh.tradeoff: 该偏好不是已实施控制的证据，也不建议向不可信网络直接开放管理接口。

en.title: Prioritize critical-site verification
en.recommendation: The entered critical-site count is a target. Verified sites remain unknown because site allocation, independent reachability and failure tests were not provided.
en.tradeoff: Create a per-critical-site evidence list and validate recovery first. Do not present fleet totals as achieved coverage.

zh.title: 优先验证关键站点
zh.recommendation: 输入关键站点数是目标。由于未提供站点分配、独立可达性与故障测试，已验证站点数保持未知。
zh.tradeoff: 建立逐关键站点证据清单，优先验证恢复，不能把全网总量当作已实现覆盖。

en.title: No critical-site target supplied
en.recommendation: Critical-site coverage is not applicable to the supplied count of zero. No sites are inferred verified, and no general resilience approval is given.
en.tradeoff: Review criticality with the service owner before using this preference to prioritize deployment.

zh.title: 未指定关键站点目标
zh.recommendation: 输入关键站点为零时，该覆盖项不适用。不推断任何站点已验证，也不授予整体韧性通过。
zh.tradeoff: 将此偏好用于部署优先级前，应与业务责任人复核关键性。

en.title: Review candidate common failure points
en.recommendation: Trace management router/switch, console server, firewall/VPN, access broker, identity/DNS and power dependencies on the actual site diagram. These are candidate dependencies, not detected topology faults.
en.tradeoff: Fleet counts cannot prove path, rack, carrier or authentication diversity. Test recovery with production connectivity unavailable.

zh.title: 复核候选共同故障点
zh.recommendation: 在实际站点图上追踪管理路由/交换、控制台服务器、防火墙/VPN、访问代理、身份/DNS及电源依赖。这是候选依赖清单，不是已检测拓扑缺陷。
zh.tradeoff: 全网数量不能证明路径、机架、运营商或认证多样性。应在生产连接不可用时测试恢复。

en.title: Dual-DC preference needs failure-domain review
en.recommendation: Two data centers are user-reported. Review independent management entry points and shared transport, identity, logging, power and inter-site dependencies.
en.tradeoff: Two locations alone do not prove redundancy or guarantee either location can recover the other. Validate actual isolation/failover behavior.

zh.title: 双数据中心偏好需要故障域复核
zh.recommendation: 用户报告双数据中心。应复核独立管理入口以及共享传输、身份、日志、电源和跨站依赖。
zh.tradeoff: 两个地点本身不能证明冗余，也不能保证相互恢复，应验证实际隔离及故障切换行为。

en.title: Management-center recovery remains unresolved
en.recommendation: No dual-DC preference is reported. Review whether the management entry point or administrative location is a common dependency and document the recovery procedure.
en.tradeoff: A single preference flag is not a topology audit; no exact single-point-of-failure count is produced.

zh.title: 管理中心恢复仍待确认
zh.recommendation: 未报告双数据中心偏好，应复核管理入口或管理地点是否是共同依赖，并记录恢复流程。
zh.tradeoff: 一个偏好标记不是拓扑审计，不输出精确单点故障数量。

en.title: Independent power is reported, not verified
en.recommendation: Trace power for console, management transport, firewall, broker and any cellular equipment. The flag does not verify runtime, feeds or all dependent equipment.
en.tradeoff: Validate the power failure scenario with site constraints and equipment specifications; no autonomy duration or power capacity is sized here.

zh.title: 独立电源已报告但未验证
zh.recommendation: 追踪控制台、管理传输、防火墙、代理及蜂窝设备的供电。该标记不能验证续航、馈电或全部依赖设备。
zh.tradeoff: 按现场约束与设备规格验证电源故障场景；本工具不计算续航时长或电源容量。

en.title: Power dependency requires resolution
en.recommendation: Independent power is not reported. OOB equipment may share the outage affecting production; record the affected path and establish an appropriate site power/recovery plan.
en.tradeoff: Network path diversity does not itself power equipment. No battery runtime or generator requirement can be inferred from these inputs.

zh.title: 电源依赖需要解决
zh.recommendation: 未报告独立电源，OOB设备可能与生产共受电源故障影响。应记录受影响路径并制定适当的现场供电/恢复方案。
zh.tradeoff: 路径多样性本身不能为设备供电，不能根据这些输入推定电池续航或油机需求。

en.title: Device-to-site distribution needs review
en.recommendation: There are fewer listed devices than sites. This may reflect empty sites or incomplete inventory; review allocation rather than assigning fractional/equal device counts.
en.tradeoff: No per-site console count or verified critical coverage is inferred.

zh.title: 设备与站点分布需复核
zh.recommendation: 已列设备少于站点，可能存在空站或清单不全；应复核分配，而非按比例或均分设备。
zh.tradeoff: 不推断逐站控制台数量或已验证关键覆盖。

en.title: Planning result; vendor/site validation required
en.recommendation: Recommendations, assumptions and trade-offs remain a repeatable planning model. User review marks are assertions only, not verified compliance, security or resilience.
en.tradeoff: Validate actual device support, allocation, protected access, transport and power failures before approving implementation.

zh.title: 规划结果；需要厂商及现场验证
zh.recommendation: 建议、假设及权衡属于可重复规划模型。用户复核标记仅是声明，不代表已验证合规、安全或韧性。
zh.tradeoff: 批准实施前验证实际设备支持、分配、受保护访问及传输和电源故障场景。

en.title: Management reachability
en.review: Review a dedicated management boundary and actual device paths.

zh.title: 管理可达性
zh.review: 复核专用管理边界及实际设备路径。

en.title: Recovery access
en.review: Review production-outage access and identity/DNS dependencies.

zh.title: 恢复访问
zh.review: 复核生产故障下的访问及身份/DNS依赖。

en.title: Least privilege
en.review: Review permitted administrative roles and device access limits.

zh.title: 最小权限
zh.review: 复核获准管理角色及设备访问限制。

en.title: Authenticated access
en.review: Review authenticated protected sessions and MFA support/policy.

zh.title: 认证访问
zh.review: 复核经认证的受保护会话及MFA支持/策略。

en.title: Auditable access
en.review: Review session/event logs, ownership and outage availability.

zh.title: 可审计访问
zh.review: 复核会话/事件日志、责任及故障下可用性。

en.title: Vendor/site constraints
en.review: Review console types, placement, power and recovery evidence.

zh.title: 厂商/现场约束
zh.review: 复核控制台类型、位置、电源及恢复证据。
